templates.name: 节日视频贺卡 · 新年金色烟花粒子
templates.name_en: Video Greeting - New Year Golden Fireworks
templates.description: 新年视频贺卡：夜空金色烟花绽放、发光金字祝福、粒子汇聚，5 秒喜庆开场
templates.description_en: New Year video card: golden fireworks blooming in the night sky, glowing golden greeting text, particles gathering, a five-second festive opening
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
Cinematic New Year video greeting card, 5 seconds. Deep navy night sky; elegant golden firework particles burst and bloom in slow motion, tracing glowing script typography "Happy New Year" / 新年快乐 across the frame; sparkling bokeh and drifting golden embers; soft light rays sweep in from the edges; smooth 3D camera push-in on the glowing title, luxurious and magical holiday atmosphere, 8K render quality.
（新年视频贺卡：深蓝夜空，金色烟花粒子慢镜绽放，勾勒发光书法字祝福语，光斑与金屑飘落，镜头缓缓推近标题，奢华梦幻节日氛围。）

overall_soundscape:
Distant crackling fireworks bursts, soft whoosh of embers, gentle wind; celebratory but not harsh; master audio clear.
（远处烟花绽放的噼啪声，金屑飘落的轻响与微风，喜庆而不刺耳，主音量清晰。）

non_diegetic_music:
Elegant orchestral holiday fanfare with soft strings and chimes, crescendo on the title reveal, fading out at the end, low volume under the soundscape.
（优雅的节日管弦短曲，弦乐与风铃，标题出现时渐强，结尾渐弱，音量压低于音效之下。）

templates.name: 节日视频贺卡 · 春节红色灯笼
templates.name_en: Video Greeting - Spring Festival Red Lanterns
templates.description: 春节视频贺卡：红灯笼升起、剪纸福字与烟花、国潮喜庆，5 秒新春祝福
templates.description_en: Spring Festival video card: red lanterns rising, paper-cut fu characters and fireworks, guochao festive style, a five-second New Year greeting
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
Cinematic Chinese New Year video greeting card, 5 seconds. A row of glowing red lanterns rises gently from the bottom, paper-cut patterns of the zodiac and "福" characters flash across in gold foil style; golden fireworks bloom behind; warm red and gold palette, silk texture, smooth camera pan revealing the festive title "新年快乐" with elegant calligraphy; 8K render quality.
（春节视频贺卡：红灯笼缓缓升起，剪纸生肖与金色福字闪切，背后金色烟花绽放，暖红金色调，镜头平移揭示书法标题「新年快乐」。）

overall_soundscape:
Festive firecrackers in the distance, cheerful crowd ambience, gentle whoosh of lanterns rising; lively Lunar New Year atmosphere.
（远处鞭炮声与欢乐人群氛围，灯笼升起的轻响，热闹的春节气氛。）

non_diegetic_music:
Joyful Chinese festive orchestral music with gong and drum hits, bright and upbeat, ending on a warm sustained chord.
（欢快的中式节日管弦乐，锣鼓点明快，结尾温暖长音。）

templates.name: 节日视频贺卡 · 情人节粒子爱心
templates.description: 情人节视频贺卡：金色/粉色粒子汇聚成爱心、玫瑰花绽放、浪漫光效，5 秒
templates.description_en: Valentine's video card: gold and pink particles gathering into a heart, roses blooming, romantic light effects, five seconds
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
Cinematic Valentine's Day video greeting card, 5 seconds. Thousands of soft pink and gold light particles swirl and converge into a glowing 3D heart in the center; red roses bloom around the heart in slow motion with dew sparkles; shimmering bokeh background; smooth camera orbit around the heart, romantic dreamy lighting; title "Happy Valentine's Day" fades in beneath; 8K render quality.
（情人节视频贺卡：粉金色光粒子旋聚成发光3D爱心，周围玫瑰慢镜绽放，光斑背景，镜头环绕爱心，浪漫梦幻。）

overall_soundscape:
Soft heartbeat thump synced to the heart formation, gentle rose petal rustle, warm dreamy ambience; romantic and tender.
（爱心汇聚同步的轻柔心跳声，玫瑰花瓣轻响，温暖梦幻氛围，浪漫柔情。）

non_diegetic_music:
Tender piano and string love theme, warm and delicate, subtle rise as the heart completes, gentle fade-out.
（温柔的钢琴与弦乐爱情主题，细腻温暖，爱心完成时轻微渐强，结尾轻柔淡出。）

templates.name: 节日视频贺卡 · 母亲节花束绽放
templates.name_en: Video Greeting - Mother's Day Blooming Bouquet
templates.description: 母亲节视频贺卡：康乃馨/牡丹花束慢镜绽放、蝴蝶光效、温情字幕，5 秒
templates.description_en: Mother's Day video card: a carnation and peony bouquet blooming in slow motion, butterfly light effects, warm subtitles, five seconds
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
Cinematic Mother's Day video greeting card, 5 seconds. A luxurious bouquet of carnations and peonies blooms in ultra slow motion, petals unfurl with light and dew drops sparkling; soft golden butterflies flutter around; warm cream and pink palette, soft studio lighting; elegant serif title "Happy Mother's Day" fades in; gentle 3D camera pull-back; 8K render quality.
（母亲节视频贺卡：康乃馨与牡丹花束极致慢镜绽放，花瓣舒展带露珠闪光，金色蝴蝶环绕，奶油粉暖调，标题优雅淡入，镜头缓缓后拉。）

overall_soundscape:
Gentle flower petal unfolding sounds, soft butterfly wing flutters, warm serene ambience with a hint of birdsong; tender and peaceful.
（花瓣舒展的轻柔声响，蝴蝶振翅，温暖宁静的氛围点缀鸟鸣，柔和平和。）

non_diegetic_music:
Warm acoustic piano with soft strings and music box chimes, heartfelt and gentle, like a lullaby for mom, fading out softly.
（温暖的原声钢琴配轻柔弦乐与八音盒音，如献给妈妈的摇篮曲，轻柔淡出。）

templates.name: 节日视频贺卡 · 儿童节 3D 气球蛋糕
templates.name_en: Video Greeting - Children's Day 3D Balloons & Cake
templates.description: 六一儿童节视频贺卡：3D 卡通气球升空、纸杯蛋糕、彩虹糖果、萌趣欢快，5 秒
templates.description_en: Children's Day video card: 3D cartoon balloons rising, cupcakes, rainbow candy, playful and cheerful, five seconds
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
Cinematic Children's Day video greeting card, 5 seconds. Cute 3D cartoon balloons in candy colors float up from the bottom, a giant cupcake with a smiling face spins in the center, rainbow arcs and stars twinkle; tiny cartoon animals wave; playful bounce motion, vibrant but soft candy lighting; rounded title "Happy Children's Day" pops in; 8K render quality.
（儿童节视频贺卡：糖果色3D卡通气球升空，笑脸纸杯蛋糕居中旋转，彩虹星星闪烁，小动物挥手，弹跳运动，糖果色柔和光照，圆体标题弹出。）

overall_soundscape:
Playful cartoon pop and chime sounds, balloon squeaks, cheerful laughter of children in the distance; light and fun.
（俏皮的卡通音效与叮咚声，气球吱吱声，远处儿童欢笑声，轻松有趣。）

non_diegetic_music:
Bouncy cheerful children's theme with ukulele, glockenspiel and hand claps, upbeat and innocent, ends on a bright chord.
（欢快的儿童主题乐，尤克里里、钟琴与拍手，明快纯真，明亮和弦收尾。）

templates.name: 节日视频贺卡 · 中秋玉兔明月
templates.name_en: Video Greeting - Mid-Autumn Jade Rabbit & Moon
templates.description: 中秋视频贺卡：水墨玉兔奔月、满月流云、桂花飘落、典雅团圆，6 秒
templates.description_en: Mid-Autumn video card: an ink-wash jade rabbit flying to the moon, the full moon and drifting clouds, osmanthus petals falling, an elegant reunion mood, six seconds
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
Cinematic Mid-Autumn Festival video greeting card, 6 seconds. A full moon rises over ink-wash mountains, a white jade rabbit hops across clouds toward the moon; osmanthus petals drift down with golden light; Chinese ink and wash style with warm moon gold accents; elegant calligraphy title "中秋快乐 · 月圆人团圆" fades in with a red seal stamp; slow camera push-in; 8K render quality.
（中秋视频贺卡：水墨山水间满月升起，玉兔踏云奔月，桂花金辉飘落，水墨质感配暖金月色，书法标题淡入带朱红印章，镜头缓慢推近。）

overall_soundscape:
Soft wind over mountains, gentle rabbit hop sounds, petals falling whisper; serene and poetic autumn night ambience.
（山间轻风，玉兔轻跳声，花瓣飘落细语，宁静诗意的秋夜氛围。）

non_diegetic_music:
Elegant Chinese guzheng and flute piece, contemplative and warm, subtle crescendo on the title reveal, gentle fade-out.
（典雅的古筝与笛曲，沉静温暖，标题出现时轻微渐强，轻柔淡出。）

templates.name: 节日视频贺卡 · 国庆红旗礼花
templates.name_en: Video Greeting - National Day Flags & Salutes
templates.description: 国庆视频贺卡：红旗飘扬、礼花绽放、华表剪影、庄重盛大，5 秒
templates.description_en: National Day video card: red flags flying, fireworks blooming, the silhouette of a huabiao pillar, solemn and grand, five seconds
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
Cinematic National Day video greeting card, 5 seconds. Red flags ripple proudly in the wind, grand fireworks salute bursts in red and gold over a skyline with the Huabiao column silhouette; doves fly across; majestic camera crane-up shot; red and gold patriotic palette; bold title "盛世华诞 · Happy National Day" with metallic sheen; 8K render quality.
（国庆视频贺卡：红旗迎风飘扬，红金礼花在华表剪影上空盛大绽放，白鸽飞过，镜头庄重升起，红金主旋律配色，金属质感标题。）

overall_soundscape:
Grand firework salutes, flag flapping, cheering crowd in the distance, national anthem hint in ambient; majestic and uplifting.
（盛大礼花声，旗帜飘动，远处群众欢呼，环境里隐约的庄严旋律，振奋人心。）

non_diegetic_music:
Majestic orchestral anthem with brass and drums, dignified and inspiring, strong crescendo at the fireworks peak, triumphant ending.
（庄严的管弦乐曲，铜管与鼓，礼花高潮时强烈渐强，凯旋式收尾。）

templates.name: 节日视频贺卡 · 万圣节南瓜鬼屋
templates.name_en: Video Greeting - Halloween Pumpkin & Haunted House
templates.description: 万圣节视频贺卡：南瓜灯亮起、蝙蝠飞过、诡异又俏皮的光效，5 秒
templates.description_en: Halloween video card: jack-o'-lanterns lighting up, bats flying past, eerie yet playful light effects, five seconds
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
Cinematic Halloween video greeting card, 5 seconds. A carved jack-o'-lantern's face lights up with a warm orange glow, its smile flickers; bats fly across a full moon, silhouettes of ghosts drift; purple mist swirls; spooky yet playful lighting; title "Happy Halloween" in gothic letters with cobwebs; smooth camera dolly-in; 8K render quality.
（万圣节视频贺卡：南瓜灯脸亮起橙光微笑闪烁，蝙蝠飞过圆月，幽灵剪影飘动，紫雾流转，诡异又俏皮，哥特字体标题配蛛网，镜头缓缓推进。）

overall_soundscape:
Creaking and whooshing wind, bat wing flaps, pumpkin flicker sounds, distant howls; spooky but playful.
（吱呀作响的风声，蝙蝠振翅，南瓜灯火苗闪烁声，远处轻嚎，诡异而有趣。）

non_diegetic_music:
Playful-spooky music box waltz with eerie strings and a touch of organ, winking at the viewer, ends with a cute boo.
（俏皮诡异的八音盒圆舞曲配怪诞弦乐与风琴，结尾一声俏皮的吓唬。）

templates.name: 节日视频贺卡 · 圣诞 3D 贺卡翻开
templates.description: 圣诞视频贺卡：立体贺卡翻开弹出圣诞树雪屋、雪花飘落、麋鹿雪橇，6 秒
templates.description_en: Christmas video card: a pop-up card opening to reveal a Christmas tree and snow cabin, snow falling, reindeer and sleigh, six seconds
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
Cinematic Christmas video greeting card, 6 seconds. A 3D pop-up greeting card opens with a satisfying motion, a paper-cut Christmas tree and snowy cabin pop out in layered depth; snowflakes fall, a reindeer sleigh flies across the starry sky; warm candlelight glow inside; classic red-green-gold palette; title "Merry Christmas" with gold foil sparkle; camera arcs around the card; 8K render quality.
（圣诞视频贺卡：3D立体贺卡翻开，纸雕圣诞树与雪屋层层弹出，雪花飘落，麋鹿雪橇划过星空，内透烛光暖光，红绿金经典配色，金字标题闪烁，镜头环绕。）

overall_soundscape:
Satisfying card opening snap, soft snow falling, sleigh bells jingling in the distance, warm fire crackle; cozy festive.
（贺卡翻开的清脆声响，雪花飘落，远处雪橇铃铛声，温暖炉火噼啪，温馨节日。）

non_diegetic_music:
Classic Christmas carol arrangement with celesta, strings and sleigh bells, warm and joyful, gentle ending.
（经典圣诞颂歌改编，钢片琴、弦乐与雪橇铃，温暖欢快，柔和收尾。）

templates.name: 节日视频贺卡 · 生日金色粒子蛋糕
templates.name_en: Video Greeting - Birthday Golden Particles & Cake
templates.description: 生日视频贺卡：金色粒子汇聚蛋糕与蜡烛、彩带飘落、欢庆闪耀，5 秒
templates.description_en: Birthday video card: golden particles gathering into a cake with candles, confetti falling, festive sparkle, five seconds
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
Cinematic Birthday video greeting card, 5 seconds. Golden particles swirl and assemble into a 3D birthday cake with lit candles, confetti and ribbons burst around; sparkling bokeh, warm celebratory lighting; playful camera tilt around the cake; bold title "Happy Birthday" with golden glow; 8K render quality.
（生日视频贺卡：金色粒子旋聚成3D生日蛋糕，蜡烛点亮，彩带亮片迸发，光斑闪耀，暖光喜庆，镜头环绕蛋糕，金色光晕标题。）

overall_soundscape:
Party popper bursts, confetti rustle, gentle candle flicker, cheerful crowd cheering "Happy Birthday"; festive and lively.
（礼花筒迸发，彩带飘落，烛火摇曳，人群欢呼「生日快乐」，喜庆热闹。）

non_diegetic_music:
Upbeat birthday party pop theme with brass stabs, hand claps and a bright piano riff, celebratory, ends with a cheerful flourish.
（明快的生日派对流行乐，铜管强音、拍手与明亮钢琴，喜庆热闹，欢快收尾。）

templates.name: 节日视频贺卡 · 婚礼戒指光效
templates.description: 婚礼祝福视频贺卡：钻石戒指光效旋转、花瓣飘落、双心光斑、唯美神圣，6 秒
templates.description_en: Wedding blessing video card: a diamond ring rotating in a glow, petals falling, twin-heart bokeh, beautiful and sacred, six seconds
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
Cinematic wedding greeting video card, 6 seconds. A sparkling diamond ring rotates slowly in soft golden light, petals and light particles drift around; two glowing hearts form in the bokeh background; elegant white and gold palette, ethereal studio lighting; refined serif title "Happy Wedding · 百年好合" fades in with lace-like frame; slow camera orbit; 8K render quality.
（婚礼祝福视频贺卡：钻石戒指在柔光中缓慢旋转，花瓣与光粒飘散，背景光斑中双心浮现，白金配色，空灵打光，精致衬线标题配蕾丝感边框淡入，镜头缓慢环绕。）

overall_soundscape:
Gentle chime and crystal ring sounds, soft petal fall, distant celebratory bells; sacred and romantic.
（轻柔的风铃与水晶叮咚，花瓣飘落，远处祝福钟声，神圣浪漫。）

non_diegetic_music:
Elegant wedding waltz with piano, strings and harp, heartfelt and pure, soft crescendo at the ring reveal, gentle fade-out.
（优雅婚礼圆舞曲，钢琴、弦乐与竖琴，真挚纯净，戒指显现时轻柔渐强，柔和淡出。）

templates.name: 节日视频贺卡 · 教师节手绘花束
templates.name_en: Video Greeting - Teachers' Day Hand-drawn Flowers
templates.description: 教师节视频贺卡：手绘粉笔花束绽放、黑板光效、温暖感恩字幕，5 秒
templates.description_en: Teachers' Day video card: a hand-drawn chalk bouquet blooming, blackboard light effects, warm grateful subtitles, five seconds
templates.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description:
Cinematic Teachers' Day video greeting card, 5 seconds. A hand-drawn chalk flower bouquet blooms on a green chalkboard, chalk dust sparkles as petals draw themselves; warm sunlight rays sweep across, books and an apple appear gently; hand-drawn crayon texture with warm amber lighting; handwritten title "老师辛苦了 · Happy Teachers' Day" appears stroke by stroke; gentle camera push-in; 8K render quality.
（教师节视频贺卡：绿色黑板上手绘粉笔花束逐笔绽放，粉笔灰如星光闪烁，暖阳扫过，书本与苹果浮现，蜡笔手绘质感，手写标题逐笔显现，镜头轻推。）

overall_soundscape:
Chalk drawing scratch sounds, soft chalk dust rustle, gentle classroom ambience with distant school bell; warm and nostalgic.
（粉笔书写声，粉笔灰细响，教室氛围与远处上课铃声，温暖怀旧。）

non_diegetic_music:
Warm acoustic guitar and soft piano melody, nostalgic and grateful, gentle build, warm ending chord.
（温暖的原声吉他配柔和钢琴，怀旧感恩，舒缓推进，温暖和弦收尾。）
